t: Heavy duty Forge Steel triple cup suction lifter is an essential tool for safely handling large, smooth materials on site. Engineered for glaziers, fabricators, and installers, this robust device securely grips panes of glass, doors, windows, and sheet metal. The 3 rubber pads, each 166mm in diameter, create powerful suction on non-porous surfaces. A reliable lever-operated mechanism provides a maximum lifting capacity of 100kg with ease. The durable ABS body and fixed plastic handle provide confident control and lasting performance during challenging tasks.
b: Effective For Glass, Doors, Windows & Sheet Metal
Triple Suction Cups for Enhanced Grip
